system.description:
Scout-Nin Keyword: Specialized

When a creature within 5 feet of you would move away from you any number of feet, you may, as a reaction, spend 1 Superiority Die. When you do, you become invisible and move up to your speed, ignoring difficult terrain and other creatures spaces, ending your movement as close as possible to the triggering creature and your invisibility immediately ends. You then immediately make one weapon attack against the creature adding the Superiority Die to the damage rolled.
